issues.source_quote: Огурцов висит в лифте между вторым и третьим этажом
issues.translation_quote: Ogurtsov is stuck in the elevator between the second and third floors
issues.justification: The Russian 'висит' echoes the earlier 'Висит, висит!' and the comic image of a dangling director; 'stuck' flattens it. Minor on its own, but the repeated 'He's stuck, he's stuck!' loses the joke of hanging.

In the source the second line is Ogurtsov's reaction to Telegin being addressed/arriving; the exchange is muddled and the following 'Ah, together with your wife' makes little sense, so the scene's comic servility is confused.

issues.translation_quote: With Cucumber, thank you very much
issues.justification: 'Огурцов' is rendered as 'Cucumber' once, while elsewhere it stays 'Ogurtsov'. The grandfather's mangling of the name is a joke, but the inconsistent handling is confusing and the pun is not set up for the English audience.

issues.source_quote: Нужно, чтоб музыка тебя так сказать.. Брала! Нужно, как говориться, чтоб она тебя вела! Но в тоже время и не уводила..
issues.translation_quote: grab you! It has to, as they say, lead you along! But at the same time not lead you astray...
issues.justification: Ogurtsov's pseudo-profound bureaucratic nonsense is partly preserved, but 'А и Б играли на трубе' (a reference to the folk riddle/tale) is rendered as 'Just a lot of tootling on trumpets', losing the allusion and the absurd tone.
The deliberate mispronunciation is rendered as 'seerious', which looks like a typo rather than a recognizable dialect marker, and it is inconsistent: Ogurtsov elsewhere speaks standard English.

issues.source_quote: Вы, наверное, думаете, что они только мороженое подают? А они подают большие надежды!
issues.translation_quote: But they also serve up great promise!
issues.justification: Acceptable pun, but 'Ансамбль пенсии и пляски' ('Pension and Dance Ensemble') is kept while the Russian pun on 'Песни' / 'пенсии' is lost, since 'Pension' and 'Song' do not sound alike in English.

issues.source_quote: Есть ли жизнь на Марсе, нет ли жизни на Марсе, это науке неизвестно.
issues.translation_quote: [The best cognac in USSR was known as 5*]
issues.justification: A translator's note inserted into the subtitle text is inappropriate for subtitles; the drunken lecturer's joke about 'five stars' should be conveyed within the dialogue or omitted.

issues.translation_quote: And look with the aided eye!..
issues.justification: 'Aided eye' is unnatural English; 'with the naked eye' contrast ('armed eye') or 'the trained eye' would be more idiomatic.

issues.translation_quote: - Bitter! Bitter! - What? It's bitter, comrades, to feel that we've grown a year older
issues.justification: 'Горько!' is the Russian wedding toast demanding a kiss; literal 'Bitter!' loses the cultural reference and the joke linking it to Grisha and Lena.

issues.source_quote: Подошёл сейчас ко мне один неизвестный
issues.translation_quote: A stranger just came up to me
issues.justification: The following joke 'известный-неизвестный' is rendered as 'known stranger', which is awkward and lacks the playfulness of the original.
Mixed-up surname is probably deliberate in the source announcement, but the second variant is not signaled; also 'conveyanced me' is invented/unnatural for 'провезения'.
Childish register is kept, but 'beddy-byes' sounds overly American-nursery and slightly off for a Soviet bureaucrat.
Wordplay is not carried across because 'Song' vs 'Pension' lacks phonetic similarity in English.

issues.source_quote: Позвольте мне также коротко познакомить вас с некоторыми цифрами
issues.translation_quote: I have prepared theses and here, so to speak...
issues.justification: 'Theses' is an overly literal rendering of 'тезисы'; 'talking points' or 'notes' would be natural.

issues.source_quote: Зря картину не взяли по перечислению
issues.translation_quote: Shame we didn't take the painting by bank transfer
issues.justification: Literal bureaucratic term rendered awkwardly; the joke of acquiring art via the budget is obscure.
